components.label: Investments at fair value
components.source: Filing accession 0001193125-26-221936, March 31, 2026 XBRL investments-at-fair-value fact

evidence.quote: Accession 0001193125-26-221936 reports investments at fair value of $1,562,470,000 as of March 31, 2026.

rationale: The filing's single investments-at-fair-value fact is the grand total. It equals the companyfacts value and represents 96.59% of total assets, leaving $55,184,000 of non-investment assets, which is plausible for a BDC. The extracted holdings sum of $1,546,856,000 undershoots this filing anchor by $15,614,000 and therefore is incomplete; the companyfacts tag did not capture merely a schedule subtotal.
